interpretation.plain_speak: Sixteen more untouched unshifted phases still produce only the same 620/623 native states, and the old correction remains essentially exact there. This confirms in-regime stability, not broader generalization.
interpretation.north_star_question: Confirms that calibration failure seen under endogenous shifts is a regime boundary rather than ordinary later-phase drift.
interpretation.next_stage: use the endogenous-shift lineage to map required calibration factor against native state without fitting a new correction
